confirmed_properties: Initial fixed-width usage prefix is admitted and charged through the same Writer before payload/closing JSON.

Cumulative byte arithmetic remains within validated 64MiB ceiling; Writer append preserves remaining-length invariant.
Encoding and quota errors return no PreparedReceipt; sticky control errors are authoritative at outer run acceptance.
Usage snapshot returns an owned fixed scalar copy, exposes no mutable accounting and does not itself consume work.
